value.rationale: The theorem uniformly determines the entire integral homotopy type for all finite triangle-free H rather than a fixed small graph or a face count. It transfers any nontrivial independence-complex topology to a natural infinite family of three-clique-free complexes, with a universal and exact binomial circle correction. H=C6 gives a concrete nonchordal mixed-dimensional wedge of three circles and six two-spheres; previously known split-graph cases have no suspended homology. This provides a reusable structural reduction, not a routine parameter increment.
